<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>forge-skill-from-conversations</code></p>

Build one focused skill candidate from recurring conversation evidence and evaluate it behind explicit approval gates.

## When to use

Turn one recurring workflow from supplied or available conversations into a focused, evaluated skill candidate. Use only when explicitly requested and require approval before creation or adoption.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link forge-skill-from-conversations --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link forge-skill-from-conversations --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Examples

### Create a skill from recent work

**Prompt**

> Use the forge-skill-from-conversations skill on these selected completed tasks and propose one reusable skill candidate.

**Expected outcome**

One evidence-backed candidate, a stop for approval, an isolated implementation, and held-out evaluation before adoption.

### Use supplied conversation evidence

**Prompt**

> Use the forge-skill-from-conversations skill on this transcript. Do not scan other tasks or install anything without asking.

**Expected outcome**

A privacy-scoped skill-forging flow that preserves separate approval for the candidate and its installation.
